adopt-only-if-better.rule: Adopt a new checkpoint or model only when it beats the incumbent on the frozen protocol at equal-or-better inductor ratio; ties go to the incumbent, and both the real costs and the real gains get stated even when the verdict is ADOPT.

attribution-control-same-session.rule: Ship every new-data or new-channel arm with a same-session control that preserves everything except the variable under test.

better-passives-can-fail.rule: Sweep component quality in both directions and re-check any match-critical point at Q = {8, 20}, not only at nominal.

calibrate-fidelity-parameters-to-real-si.rule: Calibrate every budget or fidelity parameter to the nearest real measured silicon or layout practice, verify the new bound still binds, and report the over-grant when the result uses less than was approved.

capability-negative-names-its-selector.rule: Name the selector that produced the candidates whenever recording a capability negative, and re-draw the pool by any newly measured predictor before believing it.

critic-collapse-is-coverage-not-capacity.rule: Evaluate a learned ranker on the exact distribution the search will generate, and repair a field collapse by covering that distribution before touching the model.

cross-simulator-port-must-be-measured.rule: Prove a second simulator's port on DC and S21 against a live run of the first before reading any design number from it, and never trust a model-card version string.

diagnosis-and-ranking-compete-for-capaci.rule: Ship diagnosis heads as a separate model from the ranker, and grow the move repertoire before expecting pointed search to find wins.

element-names-are-the-contract.rule: Resolve every circuit role in a netlist post-processor from element names, cross-checked against a second element that must touch the node, and raise rather than guess when the contract drifts.

era-cutover-is-a-new-label-domain.rule: Stamp every harness change on every row, never pool two eras in one training set or ranking, and relabel append-only behind an old-geometry replay fence.

friis-grow-the-quietest-parent.rule: Apply a gain-stage-add move to the quietest parent, not the lowest-violation one, and never extrapolate an NF-per-dB-of-S21 exchange rate across the knee.

frozen-protocol-change-needs-user-signof.rule: Surface any change to a frozen protocol, a spec constraint or a harness-fidelity parameter as an explicit user decision, and record the correction's exact size when it lands.

gate-driven-input-is-quiet-only-when-unm.rule: When a candidate reads sub-1 dB NF and refuses to match, check whether the port reaches only a gate and apply moves.m_input_class_swap before spending another sizing budget.

golden-before-any-design-number.rule: Validate every new harness against closed form and print GREEN before reading a single design number from it.

harden-against-the-measured-sweep.rule: Re-size the shipped point to hold the sweep-derived nominal floors as hard constraints, then re-check it at both supply nominals before designating it.

iip3-output-swing-wall.rule: When the output intercept is flat across bands AND across independently-descended sizings, stop sizing and change the topology or the bias/rail budget.

judge-linearity-at-the-min-gain-state.rule: Measure IIP3 at the min-gain state of the programmability configuration, and treat gain programmability as a prerequisite of the linearity gate rather than its successor.

margin-is-the-currency.rule: Budget explicit leftover margin on every gated constraint at designation time, because the tier-3 gates are paid for out of leftover current and match margin.

match-margin-forbids-mid-chain-loading.rule: Sweep an ideal blocked shunt load at every circuit role first and design any gain/attenuation mechanism only inside the match-legal set.

must-fail-control-in-every-golden.rule: Ship every golden with at least one control that must FAIL, and when a golden fails, converge the method instead of moving the bar.

ndl-is-blind-to-function.rule: Report the all-MOS-conducting rate beside NDL@256 on every pool, and never rest an adoption decision on NDL alone.

numerical-distortion-lands-on-signal-bin.rule: Bound a transient distortion harness with a null circuit (a3 = 0) or a step-refinement test, never with a product-free noise-floor bin.

objective-only-protects-what-it-scores.rule: Put every constraint a claim depends on into the optimizer's acceptance rule, and read any constraint the objective pins as sitting exactly on its boundary.

oracle-control-before-a-surrogate-claim.rule: Run the gate with the true metrics as predictions and report that oracle skip rate before quoting any surrogate number.

passive-instrument-must-be-proved-passiv.rule: Ship a logging hook or a perturbation-injection mechanism only with a golden showing the metric vector is identical with the mechanism present and absent.

pre-registration-before-code.rule: Commit the plan, the bars and the numbered predictions before the first line of experiment code, and honour the pre-registered consequence when a bar fails.

reference-expansion-perturbs-only-what-c.rule: Version every novelty reference with a content digest, re-measure the affected arms under both versions, and expect a non-constant, non-order-preserving correction exactly where an arm could have copied the new content.

replay-fence-before-any-reuse.rule: Re-evaluate a stored point from its own tokens and parameters before polishing, relabeling or claiming it, and quarantine the row rather than proceed when it does not reproduce.

replay-fence-is-not-correctness.rule: Pair every replay fence with an independent cross-check that could return a different number -- a hand calculation, a second harness, or an audited quantity the run must reproduce.

s11-idd-knife-edge.rule: Sweep temperature, supply, all passives and inductor Q at the fixed shipped point before designating it, and carry the sweep-derived nominal floors rather than the gate values.

search-must-be-seeded-from-physics.rule: Seed a multi-start search from the circuit's own small-signal analysis against the measured operating point, and use best-of-all-coordinates rather than first-improvement descent.

single-finger-gate-resistance-artefact.rule: Emit MOSFETs at a layout-calibrated finger width (w_finger = 2 um here) and treat finger count as a harness-fidelity parameter, never as a knob for closing a gate.

steering-toward-memorized-structure-retu.rule: Move a generator by adding structure it has not memorised; never by steering, re-weighting or prompting it toward structure it already has.

stop-sizing-build-an-instrument.rule: After the third sizing run that answers the same capability question, build a decomposition instrument for the quantity actually in question instead of sizing again.

three-failed-loops-means-topology.rule: Escalate to the archetype library or the rulings queue once a target has survived three design-verify loops; do not spend a fourth on tuning.

two-engine-cross-validation.rule: Before believing a tier-3 number, measure it a second time with a different simulator, a different analysis kind and a different extraction estimator.

uncertainty-gate-needs-an-off-distributi.rule: Feed a trust rule a deliberately off-distribution arm before retiring it as inert, because an inert gate may be measuring your candidate distribution rather than itself.

unenforced-metric-comes-due.rule: Build the physically-correct version of every advisory or assumed metric and diff it against the one in use before any claim rests on it.

weak-inversion-saturation-blindness.rule: Classify inversion level from gm/Id (sub ~17-20 V^-1, sat ~10-12 V^-1), never from bias.saturated's |Vds| >= 1.5|Vdsat| predicate.

wideband-sdr-band-wide-match-wall.rule: Add a multi-path-feedback match archetype to the library before spending any further sizing or generation budget on wideband-sdr's band-wide S11.
